subject: credit-afford-03@3.2.0
processes: Consumer loan origination: the score supports the analyst's affordability decision for applications up to 30k EUR.
period_and_frequency: Continuous from go-live, about 1,500 applications a day, reviewed yearly.

risks.description: Scores that lean on age-correlated features decline older applicants more often.

risks.right_or_interest: access to credit and an effective remedy
risks.description: An applicant cannot understand or contest a decline influenced by the score.

human_oversight_measures: Analysts decide every application with the score, reason codes and data shown; overrides are logged and sampled monthly.

mitigations.measure: Fairness eval gate on age bands, threshold 0.80
Reason codes in the decline letter and a human review on request
addresses: access to credit and an effective remedy

governance_and_complaints: Complaints about a decision reach customer care and, if they allege discrimination, open an AI incident; the AI governance committee reviews them quarterly.
residual_risk: Low, with the weekly fairness monitoring in the PMM plan.
